title: Lanes module map
description: The `modules` value of lanes.config.json (ADRs 0008 and 0018). Strict: no other keys, so a typo is not silently ignored. Config can only add reviewers; no key removes one. scripts/lanes/modules.mjs is the validator; it also checks that each named reviewer has a .claude/agents/<name>.md file and that `imports` names existing modules, which a schema cannot express. modules.test.mjs checks that the two agree.

entries.description: The modules. The longest matching path prefix decides a file's module.

allowCycles.description: Import cycles that are tolerated, each as the files in it, in any order.

paths.description: Repo-relative path prefixes, with / and no `..`, that the module claims.

imports.description: Ids of the other modules this one may import from; its own is always allowed.

reviewers.description: Extra reviewers for a diff that touches the module's paths. Added to the built-in ones, never a replacement. Each has a .claude/agents/<name>.md file; `owner` is not a reviewer.

contracts.description: Contract path prefixes the module owns. Data only in phase 1.

owner.description: Ignored. .github/CODEOWNERS is the owner list (ADR 0031); the key stays valid so an existing map does not break.

risk.description: A module with risk sensitive adds a literal prefix of each of its paths to the sensitive set (ADR 0031). It only widens sensitivity, never narrows what paths.sensitive already holds.

test.description: The module's test command. Data only; nothing executes it in phase 1.
